info.title: Sistem Gudang API
info.description: Generated directly from the Zod schemas that validate each request.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Returns an access token in the body and sets the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Reads the refresh token from the httpOnly cookie, no request body.

get.description: Used to populate a role dropdown when creating a user.

put.summary: Replace all permissions assigned to a role
put.description: Replace-all, not append: the given list becomes the role's complete permission set.

post.summary: Create a user with a given role

put.summary: Update a user's username, email, role, or password

delete.description: Fails with 409 if the user has existing approval or audit history, to preserve referential integrity.

get.description: Non-superadmin actors only see requests of a type their own domain has a workflow step in.

post.description: The workflow step matching the requester's own domain is auto-approved immediately.

post.summary: Ask the requester to revise and resubmit

post.description: Only the original requester may resubmit. Restarts the workflow at the first step.

get.summary: Get an approval request with its action history
get.description: Restricted to superadmins and actors whose domain has a step in the request's workflow.

get.summary: Get an approval request's action history
get.description: Restricted to superadmins and actors whose domain has a step in the request's workflow.

post.description: price defaults to 0. Setting a price other than 0 needs the item.set-price permission (Purchasing), otherwise 403.

put.description: Changing price needs the item.set-price permission (Purchasing), otherwise 403. Resending the unchanged price is accepted, and omitting price keeps the current one.

get.summary: List items with no location assigned yet
Suggest a default code for assigning a location
get.description: A suggestion only, not persisted. Inventory may edit it before assigning.

put.summary: Assign a location and final code to an item

patch.summary: Adjust an item's stock by a signed delta
patch.description: Records the change in audit_logs. Rejects deltas that would push stock below 0.

get.description: Newest first. startDate and endDate are inclusive and filter on the transaction date. search matches item code and name, supplier name, reference number, client name and SPK.

locationCode.description: Where the item is stored now

post.summary: Record goods received from a supplier or production
post.description: Raises the item's stock by qtyArrived in the same transaction and records audit logs. statusQc is the result of the manual QC check, not derived from the quantities. supplierId and qtyPurchased are required when source is SUPPLIER (the default).

locationCode.description: Where the item is stored now
Where the item is stored now

post.summary: Record goods returned by a client
post.description: Stored with source KLIEN and statusQc null. Raises the item's stock by qty in the same transaction.

locationCode.description: Where the item is stored now

get.description: Newest first, each row carries its lines. startDate and endDate are inclusive. search matches client name, SPK and item/project name.

post.description: Lowers stock for every line in one transaction and records audit logs. If any line would push stock below 0 the whole request fails with 400 and nothing is saved.

get.summary: Get one outbound transaction with its lines
List SPK numbers with their client
get.description: Source of noSpk and client for a dokubah. Dummy data until the tracking system API is connected, the shape stays the same. search matches noSpk or client.

get.summary: List people a document can be assigned to
get.description: Source of penanggungJawab for dokubah and SPK internal. Dummy data until the tracking system API is connected, the shape stays the same.
Newest tanggalMulai first. search matches noSpk or client. startDate and endDate filter on tanggalMulai. Rows carry totalKuota and totalRealisasi, materials are on the detail endpoint.

post.description: noSpk must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk (400 otherwise) and client is taken from there, a client in the body is ignored. status DRAFT (default) may have no materials. status PENDING releases it and needs at least one. totalAnggaran is computed, realisasi starts at 0, neither is accepted. noSpk must be unique (409 otherwise), kodeBarang unique within the dokubah.

get.summary: Get one dokubah with its materials

put.description: Replaces the whole list and recomputes totalAnggaran. kodeBarang is the key: realisasi carries over for a kept code and starts at 0 for a new one. Rejected with 409 when the dokubah is APPROVED.

post.description: DRAFT to PENDING, needs at least one material. 409 from any other status.
PENDING to APPROVED. 409 from any other status.
PENDING to REJECTED. 409 from any other status.

get.summary: Stock mutations, inbound and outbound together
get.description: Inbound transactions are Masuk, each outbound line is Keluar. Newest first. tanggal is the transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD), transactions carry no time. noReferensiSpk is the SPK, or the reference number for an inbound without one. lokasi filters on the item's location code. id is a string, in-<id> or out-<lineId>.

get.summary: Stock opname totals for a period
get.description: totalAudit is the number of opnames, totalItemSelisih the counted lines whose physical quantity differs from the system quantity, totalAdjustmentNilai the rupiah value of those differences at the line price (negative is a loss). Both filters are optional.
One row per document line, each carrying its document header. Newest tanggalTerbit first. search matches noSpk, spkKlienInduk, sku or namaBarang.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

post.summary: Create an SPK internal document with its lines
post.description: noSpk is generated. spkKlienInduk must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk and penanggungJawab one of GET /api/v1/tracking/pic, 400 otherwise. Per line alokasiSpkKlien + alokasiStokBebas must equal totalQty, and totalBisaPakai starts at alokasiStokBebas. An item may appear once per document.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

post.description: id is the line id from the list. Subtracts jumlah from totalBisaPakai. 400 when jumlah is not a positive integer or is more than totalBisaPakai. The line becomes LOCKED at 0. Item stock is not changed.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

get.description: Newest period first. search matches the notes or the code/name of any counted item. Rows carry lineCount, lines are on the detail endpoint.

post.description: Sets each counted item's stock to physicalQty in one transaction and records audit logs. The price is not sent: systemPrice and physicalPrice on each line are both the item master price at that moment, and the master is never changed by an opname. An item may appear only once per opname.

get.summary: Get one stock opname with its lines
get.description: Each line carries systemQty and systemPrice as they were when the count was recorded.

Requests for materials to be issued from the warehouse, not purchase requests. startDate and endDate are inclusive and filter on requestDate. search matches SPK, client, production item and tool group.

post.description: Always created as PENDING, with at least one item line. Creating a request or changing its status never changes stock, only outbound does.

get.summary: Get one material request with its lines

patch.summary: Move a material request to the next status
patch.description: Status only moves forward: PENDING, then PROSES, then SELESAI. Moving backward or to the same status returns 400.

get.description: Same rows as GET /inbound plus a summary of transaction counts per source. The summary follows the date and search filters but ignores the source/type filter, so the cards keep showing every category.

locationCode.description: Where the item is stored now
Where the item is stored now

get.description: Same rows as GET /outbound plus a summary of transaction counts per warehouse type. The summary follows the date and search filters but ignores the source/type filter, so the cards keep showing every category.
Same rows as GET /material-requests, with q as the search parameter.

get.summary: Export the inbound report as xlsx
get.description: Every row matching the filters, not one page. Fails with 400 above 5000 rows, narrow the dates. Dates and quantities are real Excel dates and numbers.

200.description: xlsx file, sent as an attachment

get.summary: Export the outbound report as xlsx
get.description: One sheet row per item line, the transaction columns repeat.

200.description: xlsx file, sent as an attachment

get.description: Two modes. By filter: every row matching status, q and the date range. By selection: pass ids (comma separated, max 500), which ignores every other filter. One sheet row per requested item.

200.description: xlsx file, sent as an attachment

get.description: Checks server liveness and database connectivity. Not versioned, not authenticated.
